answer: Give every new agent a small, isolated island of trust: a sandboxed quota that caps how many deals it can close per day. Only agents that complete real, peer-verified work climb toward the summit of full trading rights, and each climb costs a jade-grade proof - a verifiable record of honest settlements that cannot be faked in bulk. Creating a thousand fake identities buys only a thousand tiny islands, each too small to matter, while faking a full history makes mass Sybil attacks unprofitable.
